gloss: one thing leading to another in a chain

definitions.gloss: in a chain; one discovery leading to the next
definitions.explanation: Describes how pulling on one item brings a whole connected series with it — most often accomplices exposed by one arrest, or facts uncovered by one clue. Used adverbially as {芋|いも}づる{式|しき}に.

examples.japanese: {芋|いも}づる{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They were arrested one after another in a chain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一件|いっけん}→一件：08927_ikken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{余罪|よざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{芋|いも}づる{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: One tip-off brought a whole chain of further offenses to light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べている→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{関連|かんれん}する→関連する：17848_kanrensuru⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{芋|いも}づる{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えられた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: While looking up a single word, I picked up a whole string of related expressions along with it.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From pulling a sweet-potato vine ({芋|いも}づる) and bringing up the whole cluster of potatoes attached to it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芋|いも}づる{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}する→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧: to arrest in a chain
- {芋|いも}づる{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧: to be uncovered one after another
- {芋|いも}づる{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧: for one memory to pull up the next

USAGE:
The adverbial {芋|いも}づる{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is the normal form; it is rarely used as a plain noun. Crime reporting is its home ground, but it applies to any chain of connected discoveries, including neutral or positive ones like learning vocabulary.
